Near upper center: broad glowing area of warm champagne, muted gold, pale ochre, soft cream with diffused edges, light filtering through mist. Middle band: deep burpropdy, plum, charcoal brown, near black irregular vertical forms suggesting distant trees or structures. Lower section: dark teal, blue gray, slate, charcoal with broken painterly vertical reflections of warm gold and mauve. Subtle pink and mauve passages blend atmospherically into the horizon. Techniques: layered glazing, palette blade scraping, dry brush, vertical drags, distressed texture; matte and impasto areas. Mood: mysterious, contemplative, elegantly luminous. No figures, animals, buildings, text, borders, or literal details. Style: moody abstract landscape, gold and mauve, teal reflective abstraction, cinematic fine art print.
